title: NoAITell Pricing: Free and Upcoming Pro Plans | NoAITell
h1: NoAITell Pricing: Free and Upcoming Pro Plans
description: Free local cleaning: 3 uses daily, 500 words each. Upcoming Pro: $4.99 day pass, $19.9 monthly, $199 yearly.
body:
Free includes 3 local cleanings per day per browser device, up to 500 words each. No login is required. The counter resets at local midnight and is stored in localStorage with only a date and use count. Scanning and reviewing do not consume a cleaning.

All upcoming Pro plans have the same features: unlimited uses and words, AI-tell replacement suggestions, and batch processing. Pro features are planned and are not available in this release. Payments will be handled through Creem when checkout launches. No payments are accepted now.
